lead: Rajesh Khanna was an Indian film actor, born on 29 December 1942 in Amritsar.
He died on 18 July 2012 in Mumbai at the age of 69.
He has 60 credited works on public record and has held the office of Member of the Lok Sabha.
This profile collects the Rajesh facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.

sections.heading: Rajesh Khanna — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Rajesh Khanna was born on 29 December 1942 in Amritsar, and holds Indian nationality.
He received his education at Ness Wadia College of Commerce, St. Sebastian Goan High School, Kishinchand Chellaram College and Hill Grange High School.

sections.heading: Rajesh Khanna — Career and Professional Work
paras: Rajesh Khanna works primarily as a film actor, politician, film producer, singer and television actor.
He has held the following offices: Member of the Lok Sabha. He is affiliated with Indian National Congress.
